categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three primary business segments: (1) National Land Space Planning (Urban and Rural Planning) - including city planning, landscape planning, municipal planning, and traffic planning; (2) Engineering Design - including architectural design, landscape design, municipal design, and rail transit design; (3) Engineering Consulting - including project consulting, assessment consulting, and full-process engineering consulting. The company also operates property rental and property management services as secondary business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced planning and design methodologies including BIM (Building Information Modeling) technology, TOD (Transit-Oriented Development) mode, EOD (Ecological-Oriented Development) mode, and smart city sensing systems. Core technical capabilities include spatial planning analysis, 3D modeling, environmental impact assessment, and integrated design solutions. The company operates research centers including the Guangdong Smart City Space Planning Engineering Technology Research Center and Shenzhen Postdoctoral Innovation Practice Base.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government departments at various levels, state-owned enterprises, and large private enterprises. Key customer types include municipal governments, natural resources departments, transportation authorities, and real estate developers. The company serves markets in urban planning, infrastructure development, urban renewal, rural revitalization, and smart city construction. Major end markets include new city development, urban renewal projects, rail transit systems, and municipal infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen and operates primarily in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area region. It has established 11 branch offices across China, with operations extending to Central China, East China, and Southwest China regions. Major operating cities include Shenzhen, Dongguan, Guangzhou, and other cities in Guangdong Province, with expanding presence in Hubei, Zhejiang, and other provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at the upstream and midstream positions of the urban construction and operation industry chain. It provides planning, design, and consulting services that precede construction and implementation phases. The company serves as a bridge between strategic planning and physical construction, offering comprehensive solutions from project conception through detailed design and construction consulting.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven development with focus on: (1) Smart city and digital transformation technologies including AI and AIGC applications; (2) Sustainable development and ecological restoration; (3) New urbanization patterns including TOD and EOD development modes; (4) Rural revitalization and village planning; (5) Urban renewal and old city transformation; (6) Infrastructure optimization including rail transit and municipal systems. R&D investments focus on data-driven decision systems and intelligent design platforms.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through professional service fees for planning and design projects. Revenue is recognized based on project completion percentage using the output method. The company operates on both competitive bidding and direct engagement models. Secondary revenue comes from property rental and property management services. Revenue is recognized over time as services are delivered, with payment typically structured in project phases.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading national planning and design firm with particular strength in urban and rural planning. It competes with other large design institutes and planning firms. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive service capabilities spanning planning, design, and consulting; strong technical expertise in national land space planning; established relationships with government and major enterprises; and presence across multiple geographic markets. The company is recognized as one of the few comprehensive planning and design enterprises capable of providing full-process solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of 292.3 million yuan, representing a 37.16% decline from 2022's 465.2 million yuan. The company reported a net loss of 52.4 million yuan in 2023 compared to net profit of 61.0 million yuan in 2022, primarily due to fair value losses on financial products. Total assets reached 1.70 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company has experienced significant fluctuations in recent years, with 2023 marked by challenging market conditions and investment losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on providing integrated, full-process solutions for national land space planning and urban construction. Key differentiators include: (1) Comprehensive service capability spanning planning, design, and consulting across multiple disciplines; (2) Deep expertise in complex urban planning challenges including urban renewal, TOD development, and ecological restoration; (3) Advanced technical capabilities including BIM, smart city systems, and data-driven analysis; (4) Established track record with government and major enterprises; (5) Commitment to sustainable and high-quality urban development aligned with national modernization goals; (6) Localized service delivery through nationwide branch network combined with centralized technical expertise.
